title: corpus-harvest extraction record (one JSONL line)
description: JSONL is the authority; markdown is generated for review. Field set per plan v0.3 provenance contract + addendum note 3 (generated_by_ai; relation carries quotation/paraphrase/synthesis).

item_id.description: Corpus item (e.g. YouTube video ID, or local-folder item id from the manifest)

source_locator.description: REQUIRED — URL, file path, or feed ref for the item

published_at.description: ISO date if known, else null

acquired_at.description: ISO date-time the corpus copy was acquired (from the acquisition receipt)

claim_type.description: creator_claimed_coinage: the corpus can prove the creator CLAIMS or USES a term as his own — never global originality

speaker.description: Who said it — the creator, a named guest, or 'unattributed'

verification_status.description: Set by validate_citations.py. ASR-origin quotes stay 'approximate' and are barred from print-candidate status until verified against audio. 'ambiguous' (repeated/multiple matches) FAILS CLOSED — flagged for review, never auto-resolved.

time_range.description: Attached mechanically by the citation validator from SEGMENTS; null until validated
